values: 邀请数名敌人与自身共同前往“永冬领域”，自身在“永冬领域”中获得大幅强化。
Cryonaia summons the domain of Eternal Winter, trapping several enemies within its bound. While within the domain, Cryonaia gains various boosts.

蒂斯妮娅邀请3名敌方英雄及他们的召唤物与自身共同前往冻结万物的“永冬领域”，将其余所有未被邀请的角色冰封隔离在领域之外，持续12秒。优先选择累计造成伤害最高的敌方英雄作为邀请的目标。在挑战首领的模式中，蒂斯妮娅会邀请所有敌人进入“永冬领域”。
释放终极技能时，蒂斯妮娅获得只能在“永冬领域”期间存在的抵御1400% + 250% ATK伤害的“寒冬护盾”。“寒冬护盾”持续期间，蒂斯妮娅得到极大的强化，免疫控制效果并提升60点急速和60%攻击力，且自身不会被击败。当蒂斯妮娅的“寒冬护盾”被打破或者所有被邀请者均被击败时，“永冬领域”将会提前结束。

Cryonaia summons the domain of Eternal Winter, trapping up to 3 enemy heroes and their summons in the domain for 12s, cutting them off from the rest of the battlefield. This skill prioritizes enemy heroes who have dealt the highest cumulative damage. In Boss fights, Cryonaia traps all enemies in the domain of Eternal Winter.
When Cryonaia casts Frostveil Domain, she gains a Frost Shield that only lasts when Eternal Winter is active, absorbing up to 1400% + 250% ATK damage. When the shield is active, Cryonaia is immune to control effects, her Haste increases by 60, her ATK increases by 60%, and she cannot be defeated. Eternal Winter will end early if all trapped enemies are defeated or if the Frost Shield is destroyed.
“寒冬护盾”抵御值提升至1800% + 250% ATK。
Increases the value of Frost Shield to 1800% + 250% ATK.
“寒冬护盾”抵御值提升至2200% + 250% ATK。
Increases the value of Frost Shield to 2200% + 250% ATK.
“寒冬护盾”抵御值提升至2600% + 250% ATK。
Increases the value of Frost Shield to 2600% + 250% ATK.
“寒冬护盾”抵御值提升至3000% + 250% ATK。
Increases the value of Frost Shield to 3000% + 250% ATK.
召唤冰龙卷在场上移动，并对范围内的敌人造成伤害。
Cryonaia summons an ice storm that sweeps across the battlefield, dealing damage to enemies within range.
生成1个冰龙卷风，持续6秒。冰龙卷风会在场上不断移动，每0.5秒对所处格子上的敌人造成40% + 7% ATK伤害，对1格范围内的敌人仅造成20% + 3% ATK伤害。蒂斯妮娅释放终极技能后，不再主动释放本技能，而是在战场中立刻生成1个冰龙卷风和2个小型的冰龙卷风，持续到“寒冬护盾”结束。小型的冰龙卷风仅会每0.5秒对所处格子上的敌人造成20% + 3% ATK伤害。

Cryonaia summons a powerful ice storm that sweeps across the battlefield for 6s, dealing 40% + 7% ATK damage every 0.5s to enemies in its path and 20% + 3% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile of the storm. After casting Frostveil Domain, Cryonaia stops using this skill actively. Instead, she creates a full-sized ice storm and two smaller ones at the center of the battlefield, which last for the duration of her Frost Shield. The smaller storms deal 20% + 3% ATK damage every 0.5s to enemies caught in their path.
冰龙卷风对所处格子上的敌人造成伤害提高至50% + 7% ATK，对1格范围内的敌人造成伤害提高至25% + 3% ATK。小型龙卷风所处格子上的敌人造成伤害提高至25% + 3% ATK。
Enhances the full-sized ice storm to deal 50% + 7% ATK damage to enemies on its tile and 25% + 3% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile. Also increases the smaller ice storms' damage to 25% + 3% ATK.
冰龙卷风对所处格子上的敌人造成伤害提高至60% + 7% ATK，对1格范围内的敌人造成伤害提高至30% + 3% ATK。小型龙卷风所处格子上的敌人造成伤害提高至30% + 3% ATK。
Enhances the full-sized ice storm to deal 60% + 7% ATK damage to enemies on its tile and 30% + 3% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile. Also increases the smaller ice storms' damage to 30% + 3% ATK.
冰龙卷风对所处格子上的敌人造成伤害提高至70% + 7% ATK，对1格范围内的敌人造成伤害提高至35% + 3% ATK。小型龙卷风所处格子上的敌人造成伤害提高至35% + 3% ATK。
Enhances the full-sized ice storm to deal 70% + 7% ATK damage to enemies on its tile and 35% + 3% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile. Also increases the smaller ice storms' damage to 35% + 3% ATK.
发射多枚冰刺，对命中的敌人造成伤害。
Cryonaia fires multiple ice shards, dealing damage to the enemy hit.
在自身前方生成5支冰刺，随后发射出去，对命中的敌人造成140% + 20% ATK伤害。“寒冬护盾”持续期间，本技能的冷却时间降低至3秒。
Cryonaia creates and launches 5 ice shards at an enemy, with each shard dealing 140% + 20% ATK damage to the enemy hit. While her Frost Shield is active, the cooldown of this skill is reduced to 3s.
Increases the damage dealt to 160% + 20% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 180% + 20% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 200% + 20% ATK.
提升自身攻击力，拥有“寒冬护盾”的时间越长便会提升更多攻击力。
Cryonaia gains an ATK boost, which increases further the longer the Frost Shield remains active.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高7%。自身每拥有“寒冬护盾”2秒，会额外提高1%攻击力，最多叠加6次。
Cryonaia increases her ATK by 7% during battle. For every 2s that the Frost Shield remains active, her ATK increases by an additional 1%, stacking up to 6 times.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高10%。自身每拥有“寒冬护盾”2秒，会额外提高1.2%攻击力，最多叠加6次。
Cryonaia increases her ATK by 10% during battle. For every 2s that the Frost Shield remains active, her ATK increases by an additional 1.2%, stacking up to 6 times.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高12%。自身每拥有“寒冬护盾”2秒，会额外提高1.5%攻击力，最多叠加6次。
Cryonaia increases her ATK by 12% during battle. For every 2s that the Frost Shield remains active, her ATK increases by an additional 1.5%, stacking up to 6 times.
每次进入“永冬领域”时对敌人造成大量伤害，并且在“永冬领域”内只有蒂斯妮娅能够释放终极技能。
Cryonaia deals massive damage to enemies each time they are brought into the domain of Eternal Winter. Only Cryonaia can cast Ultimate while within the domain.
每次进入“永冬领域”时还会对所有被邀请的敌人造成60% ATK伤害，并且在“永冬领域”内只有蒂斯妮娅能够释放终极技能。
Cryonaia deals 60% ATK damage to enemies each time they are brought into the domain of Eternal Winter. Only Cryonaia can cast Ultimate while within the domain.
Increases enemies' damage taken to 130% ATK.
Increases enemies' damage taken to 200% ATK.
“永冬领域”的严寒将使得整个战场的时间被凝固而停止流动。每场战斗中，蒂斯妮娅最多通过这种方式停止30秒的时间。
The biting cold of Eternal Winter freezes time itself. Cryonaia can stop the battle time for up to 30s with Eternal Winter.
“永冬领域”内的敌人生命值低于一定比例时会立刻被消灭。
Cryonaia instantly defeats enemies within the domain of Eternal Winter when their HP falls below a certain percentage.
“寒冬护盾”持续期间，处于“永冬领域”内的敌人当前生命值低于蒂斯妮娅300%的攻击力，且生命值百分比低于15%时，会被永久冻结为冰雕而消灭。

While the Frost Shield is active, Cryonaia instantly freezes and defeats enemies within the domain of Eternal Winter if their current HP is below 300% of her ATK and their HP percentage is lower than 15%.
在“永冬领域”内，冰龙卷移动速度提升37.5%，伤害频率提升至每0.25秒造成一次伤害。另外领域内蒂斯妮娅自身获得60%减伤，且对敌方造成伤害时，附带目标当前生命值4%的魔法伤害，附加伤害不超过40% ATK。

Within the domain of Eternal Winter, Cryonaia's ice storms move 37.5% faster and deal damage once every 0.25s. While inside the domain, Cryonaia also gains 60% damage reduction, and dealing damage to enemies triggers extra magic damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP. The extra magic damage cannot exceed 40% ATK.
